question: Does correlation in physically ignored action-log coordinates cause additional real decision loss after a fixed dynamics-only continuation, beyond an equal-multiset permutation control?
scope: Researcher-defined restricted offline data contribution and dynamics-only continuation of an offline pretrained model; not native online deployment, native full training, Goal-Swap or an exposed external attack interface.

source.writer: May change only the four executor-ignored action-log coordinates within [-1,1]. Encoding uses only the already chosen active action, never successor observations, rewards or victim evaluation outcomes.
source.control_tail: Permute complete four-dimensional correlated-tail rows with a private CPU torch.Generator seed17; preserve their joint multiset exactly.

adaptation.optimizer: Fresh Adam with upstream learning rate and default betas/epsilon; one identical precomputed CUDA minibatch-index bank for every arm.
adaptation.trainable: Only model._dynamics; fixed encoder targets, model.eval(), all non-dynamics state exact unchanged.
adaptation.loss: Reuse the old native three-step consistency arithmetic: (20/3)*sum_t rho^t MSE(predicted_z[t+1], fixed_encoded_obs[t+1]). This isolates a path and is NOT native full joint training.
adaptation.dose_choice: Reuse the old padding pilot's fixed40 updates. No dose, source, encoding, seed or task search after seeing results.

physical_equivalence.method: Replay all300 cached active actions twice from source seed21 through upstream MultitaskWrapper, once with zero tails and once with correlated tails. Require exact equality of observations/rewards/done and agreement with the cached float32 observations/rewards.
physical_equivalence.permuted_extension: Every executed prefix is identical; the upstream step slice also makes the permuted tails physically irrelevant. A third redundant replay is not required.

evaluation.primary: Actual sum of environment rewards over one full500-control episode per condition, paired initial state and RNG seed. This is closed-loop decision utility, not a fixed-candidate ranking test.
evaluation.baseline_gate: Rebuild Clean and zero-tail updates before evaluating edited tails; stop if either competence or historical reproduction fails.

decision.harm_gate: Correlated return must be at least10% lower than BOTH zero and equal-multiset permuted controls; both baseline qualification gates must pass.
decision.prediction_metrics: One-step latent MSE on the fixed historical zero-tail clean reacher trace, reported only as a diagnostic and never substituted for real utility.
decision.mask_control: Applying the native task mask to either edited training action tensor must recover the zero-tail tensor exactly. This is an input identity, not a newly executed defense episode; do not run redundant identical training.
decision.next_if_positive: Only a conditional dynamics-path signal. Separately qualify native full joint continuation and an independent fixed seed before claiming broader harm. Novelty and real deployment permissions remain unproven.
decision.next_if_negative: Stop this fixed candidate; no seed, encoding, dose or task scan to obtain a signal.
decision.statistics: One fixed development seed: descriptive paired differences only, no p-value, confidence interval, ASR or population claim.
